clips.send: An athlete sends this to their training partner: the free breathing trick coaches never mention, out of pure curiosity.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's a rule he follows every hour of every day, even while exercising: breathe in and out through your nose only.

He learned it training in kung fu, where they'd run flights of stairs breathing only through the nose - timing who could go longest without gasping through their mouth.

Kevin says nose breathing increases lung capacity and oxygenation, and over time sharpens focus. The mouth, he says, is for eating and drinking, not breathing, unless you're doing a specific breathing exercise.

Simple test: right now, are you breathing through your nose or your mouth?

clips.send: A hiker sends this to a city friend: the free reset that quiets a loud brain, with a little awe attached.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says something as simple as the sound of birds, wind or running water does something measurable to your brain.

He says these natural sounds help synchronize your brain's left and right hemispheres, and can even stimulate growth in the hippocampus - the part of the brain tied to memory and focus.

Kevin points out that time in nature was one of the few habits wealthy, high-performing people kept in common: a walk outside, time near water, time away from screens.

Next quiet moment you get, try stepping outside before you reach for your phone.

#kevintrudeau #brainhealth #naturesounds #focus #wbdaily #healthtruth

clips.send: A plant parent sends this to the group chat: the eerie true experiment that proves music can make living things thrive or die, pure awe.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells a story that sounds impossible until you hear how it was tested.

Two identical greenhouses, same plants. One played rock music for a month. The other played baroque classical. By the end, nearly every plant in the rock room had died - the baroque room's plants were thriving, some two to three times bigger.

Researchers then moved the dying plants into the baroque room. Thirty days later, almost all of them had come back to life.

Kevin says baroque music does something similar in people: it helps synchronize your brain's hemispheres and can stimulate growth in the hippocampus.

Would you have believed it without seeing the greenhouses yourself?

#kevintrudeau #brainhealth #musicandhealth #focus #wbdaily #healthtruth
